item.title: Trump to unveil TrumpRx website where Americans can purchase prescription drugs
item.description: President Donald Trump is set to unveil a government website on Thursday that will help Americans buy prescription drugs at lower costs.

item.title: Google plans to spend big as AI race with rivals intensifies
item.description: Google said returns from its AI push are strengthening growth in search, cloud and enterprise products, as Alphabet signals a major increase in AI-related capital spending.

item.title: DEI disclosure participation plummets among major companies as corporate pullback continues
item.description: A major shift is occurring in corporate America, as two-thirds fewer Fortune 500 companies submitted diversity policies, signaling a retreat from public DEI commitments.

item.title: Citi to match federal government's $1K Trump Account contributions for employees' children
item.description: Citi announced it will match the federal government's $1,000 deposits to Trump Accounts for children born to U.S. workers between January 2025 and December 2028.

item.title: Mortgage rates tick higher but remain near 6%
item.description: The average rate on a 30-year fixed mortgage rose this week to 6.11%, according to the latest Freddie Mac data released Thursday. That is up from last week's reading of 6.10%.

item.title: Homebuyers gain upper hand in 3 major cities as inventories grow
item.description: Housing inventory surges in major American metro areas, and buyers gain more choices. Seattle leads with a 32.4% increase in homes for sale.

item.title: Fans bemoan 'childhood memories' as beloved juice brand ends 80-year run
item.description: Minute Maid will soon discontinue frozen juice concentrates, sparking nostalgic reactions from fans who grew up with the 80-year-old products.

item.title: Fanatics Sportsbook sees major spike in downloads from Kendall Jenner's viral Super Bowl ad campaign
item.description: Kendall Jenner's viral Fanatics Sportsbook Super Bowl ad invoking the "Kardashian Kurse" exceeded expectations, driving massive downloads and engagement, CEO Matt King says.

item.title: President launches TrumpRx.gov website offering Americans discounted prescription drug prices: ‘Historic’
item.description: President Donald Trump unveils TrumpRx.gov with 16 pharmaceutical companies slashing prescription drug prices, including Wegovy, dropping from $1,300 to $199 monthly.

item.title: US, Argentina strike sweeping trade deal cutting tariffs, opening markets to US exports
item.description: Argentina and U.S. sign trade agreement cutting tariffs on American exports including medicines, machinery and agricultural goods in new partnership.
